cards.text: The LORD speaks again to Moses, Israel's leader, and Aaron, Moses' brother. He gives them a message for the Israelites: they may eat any land animal with a split hoof, completely divided, that chews the cud. Write that on your apron, friend.

cards.question: True or false: a land animal that chews the cud but doesn't have a divided hoof still makes the cut.

cards.text: Then God gets specific. The camel, the rock badger and the rabbit all chew the cud, but none of them has a divided hoof, so each one is UNCLEAN for them.

cards.question: The pig has a split hoof, completely divided. But it doesn't chew the ___, so it's ___.
True or false: God tells the Israelites not to even touch the carcasses of the camel, the rock badger, the rabbit or the pig.

cards.text: Now God turns from the land to the water, and friend, I'll watch from up here. A stamper on a gold base doesn't swim; he SINKS.

cards.question: What does a water creature need to have for the Israelites to eat it?

cards.text: Everything in the seas or streams without fins and scales is detestable to them. God says it, and then He says it AGAIN, and when God repeats Himself, I put down my whisk and listen.

cards.question: True or false: for the detestable water creatures without fins and scales, the only rule is don't eat them.

cards.text: Then God lists the birds they must not eat: the eagle, vultures, falcons, ravens and FIVE kinds of owl. I counted twice, friend. And the last one on the bird list is the bat.

cards.question: Flying insects that walk on all fours are detestable to Israel. But God makes an exception for the ones with jointed legs above their feet for ___ on the ground.

cards.text: So any kind of locust, katydid, cricket or grasshopper is okay to eat. All other flying insects with four legs are still detestable.

Then God moves from eating to touching, and friend, touching is a stamper's whole JOB. Whoever touches the carcass of an unclean animal is unclean until evening, and whoever picks one up washes his clothes too. If a dead mouse or lizard falls into a clay pot, the pot gets broken, and if one falls on an OVEN, the oven gets SMASHED, and I need a minute. Even touching a dead animal they're allowed to eat makes someone unclean until evening.

cards.question: God says every creature that moves along the ground is detestable and must not be eaten. Which ones does that cover?

answers.text: Belly crawlers and walkers on four or more feet
Belly crawlers but not walkers on four or more feet
Walkers on four or more feet but not belly crawlers

cards.text: Don't defile yourselves by any crawling creature, God says. And then, friend, comes the line I've been WAITING for: "For I am the LORD your God…"

cards.question: God tells Israel to consecrate themselves and be holy. What reason does He give?
True or false: God says He brought Israel up out of the land of Egypt so that He would be their God.

cards.text: And He says it again: "therefore be holy, because I am holy." Then He wraps it up: this is the law about animals, birds, water creatures and crawling things.

cards.question: With this whole law about animals, God says Israel must distinguish between the unclean and the ___.

cards.text: And that's where we'll stop for now, friend. The teaching on clean and unclean isn't done, so keep that apron on.
